name: learn45-lernagent
description: Prototype: AI learning agent for Learn45 (Zentral Hack 2026)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @l45/backend" "npm run dev -w @l45/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @l45/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @l45/animlib && npm run typecheck -w @l45/backend && npm run typecheck -w @l45/frontend && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
